intelligence.human_view: The evening's format pass kept proposing endings and his eye kept judging them — the mockup at 23:16Z, the revision at 23:20Z — and then he showed the one he wants: a picture, already beautiful, that only needs to be made alive. That is the difference between this ruling and the ones before it. He is not asking for a new design. He is pointing at a finished picture and saying: make THIS move. The picture already has the two panels, the two rows, the diamond, the five actions, the quoted lines. What it does not have is life — the filling, the 3D icons, the press, the breathing, the orbit. So the build is not a design job; it is an animation job on a design he already approved. And the colors are his picture's colors, not the Twin Rank's — purple for VALUE, blue for INTELLIGENCE — because the picture is the authority until his word says otherwise. The captain flagged the swap (one word) so the choice stays his, not the builder's.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone shows you a beautiful picture of a toy and says: this one — make it real, make it move, make every little piece a real thing you can touch. So you don't draw a new toy. You take their picture and bring it to life: the stars fill up, the icons pop out like real jewels, everything breathes and presses in and out. The colors stay exactly like the picture — purple stars for how much it's worth, blue stars for how smart it is. That is the one.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he sent a picture of the ending he likes and said: this one is quite nice — can you make it active and alive, every icon a real little jewel, so it feels truly alive? So we build that very picture, living: purple stars for the value, blue stars for the cleverness, a diamond in the middle, and five good ways to make the intelligence better underneath. Nothing flat, everything pressing in and out, breathing gently. The colors stay as he showed them — purple and blue — unless he says one word to change them.
intelligence.naya_view: THE RATING FOOTER IS THE ONE. MAKE HIS PICTURE ACTIVE AND ALIVE — STARS FILLING, EVERY ICON A REAL 3D OBJECT, PRESS IN AND OUT, BREATHING + ORBIT. VALUE PURPLE, INTELLIGENCE BLUE — AS SHOWN, NOT THE TWIN RANK'S GOLD/EMERALD. LOVE IS THE PURPLE JEWEL HEART, NO LIKE, RANKS ARE PURE SIGNAL, NO POINTS TEXT, DICTATION MIC IN THE COMPOSER.
